newsitem.title: USA: Personnel optimistic on Nursefinders deal.
newsitem.headline: Personnel optimistic on Nursefinders deal.

text.p: CHARLOTTE, July 24 (Reuter) Personnel Group of America Inc said Thursday it was optimistic that it would announce a deal for its Nursefinders unit in the second half of the year.

Personnel today reported second quarter net per fully diluted share of $0.36 on 12.5 million weighted average shares outstanding, up from $0.26 on 8.8 million weighted average shares outstanding in the same quarter a year earlier.

"Our consideration of strategic alternatives for Nursefinders has been well received and continues on track," said Chief Executive Edward Drudge Jr. "We have seen a great deal of interest in this division from potential strategic and financial buyers and continue to be optimistic that we will announce a transaction involving Nursefinders in the second half of 1997."
Drudge said he would expect to use net proceeds for acquisitions focused on information technology.
